after.CONFIRMED: the floor stops refusing H1 agreements, in a new dual-ai version, the owner told first; the lesson check, the senior, the risk engine and the always-sure seat rule stay as they are
after.otherwise: the floor stays; the result is reported as it is

spec.measure: net R as followed forward (forward.walk: the trader's levels, the H1 time exit, spread, slippage and commission); t of the mean over agreements; and the same over the UTC days' own mean net R
spec.question: on the H1 chart, would the desk's agreements under the confidence floor have paid, after costs?
spec.reported_never_judged: the agreements the floor let through (DUAL_AI) in the same windows, the win rate, the profit factor, the number decided but not resolved by the date
spec.units: every DUAL_AI_LOW_CONFIDENCE proposal on the H1 chart decided inside the look's window, in the look's partition, whose outcome the ledger recorded as RESOLVED by the look's date (forward_outcomes.ts), each decision once

verdicts.EVALUATION: only after QUALIFIED: CONFIRMED if n >= min_n, mean > min_mean_r, t >= min_t and the days' mean > min_days_mean_r; INCONCLUSIVE if n < min_n; NOT CONFIRMED otherwise
verdicts.LEARNING: QUALIFIED if n >= min_n, mean >= min_mean_r, t >= min_t and the days' t >= min_days_t; INCONCLUSIVE if n < min_n; FAILED otherwise (EVALUATION is then not judged)
